Enemies.Comment: Swarm template (30 HP, 600, hit 6). The id stays (encounters use it); the castle swarm is now a barghest: small, fast, fragile, leaps, comes in packs.
Elite ranged (provisional, 2026-11-15): a big centaur archer, keeps its distance and shoots arrows (visible projectiles); kicks up close.
Provisional (site code needs): an Orc_Future copy, a bit tougher, that carries the first gun. Its pistol drop sets GotFirstGun when picked up.
Soldier template (60 HP, ranged rifle): a skeletal robot with a hitscan rifle. Robots show sparks, not blood.
Elite template (180 HP): a floating sphere turret. Charges a heavy beam with a lagging aiming line; the core is the weak point.
Swarm template (30 HP, 600 speed, hit 6): a spider with its own skeleton that bites and lunges.
The castle boss (2026-11-15, provisional): her twin's fight (AI/GBValkyrieEnemy) drawn with the ValkyriePixel sheet; light bolts and lances are pixel sprites.

Provisional (overnight block D, 2026-11-15): her own fight (AI/GBValkyrieEnemy): bursts of light bolts from her sword while she strafes, a two or three swing combo with a hop back, a dash in, the Judgement spell (circles that grow, then pillars of light) and a fan of light lances; phase two under half health uses the P2 keys. Every number is a Stat here.
Provisional (site code needs): the Herald, the tentacle machine as a mini-boss. Same actor class and look as Entity_Phase1; health 55% (7300 -> 4015) and damage 80% (20 -> 16) of it.
